source.title: Shadewing - Undying Vow
source.name: Shadewing
source.description: A Rogue who fights with instinct and curse, he deals continuous damage that slowly pushes his enemies toward death.

skills.name: Crimson Venom

description.raw: Shadewing inflicts Crimson Venom on an enemy for 10s. While affected by Crimson Venom, the enemy takes damage every second equal to 60% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based), plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 100% (ATK-based).
active: Shadewing inflicts Crimson Venom on an enemy for 10s.
While affected by Crimson Venom, the enemy takes damage every second equal to 60% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based), plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP.
The extra damage cannot exceed 100% (ATK-based).

text: Increases Crimson Venom's base damage per second to 65% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based).
Increases Crimson Venom's base damage per second to 70% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based).
Increases Crimson Venom's base damage per second to 75% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based).
Increases Crimson Venom's base damage per second to 80% (ATK-based) + 8% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Shadewing deals heavy continuous damage to an enemy, and each hit deals extra damage based on the enemy's lost HP.

skills.name: Razor Talons

description.raw: Shadewing sinks his claw into an enemy's chest, dealing 70% (ATK-based) damage. He then rips it free, tearing the wound open and dealing 70% (ATK-based) damage again. The enemy continues to take 120% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage per second for the next 5s.
active: Shadewing sinks his claw into an enemy's chest, dealing 70% (ATK-based) damage.
He then rips it free, tearing the wound open and dealing 70% (ATK-based) damage again.
The enemy continues to take 120% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage per second for the next 5s.

text: Increases the damage of the two claw strikes to 75% (ATK-based) and the damage dealt per second from the resulting wound to 140% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of the two claw strikes to 80% (ATK-based) and the damage dealt per second from the resulting wound to 160% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Increases the damage of the two claw strikes to 85% (ATK-based) and the damage dealt per second from the resulting wound to 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Shadewing deals minor damage to an enemy, followed by more continuous damage.

skills.name: Withering Curse

description.raw: When a battle starts, Shadewing soars into the enemy formation, inflicting Withering Curse on all enemies. During the flight, Shadewing is invincible. Withering Curse reduces enemies' Phys & Magic DEF by 20% and converts any continuous damage they take into curse value. When the curse value reaches the lesser of 20% of an enemy's max HP or 400% of Shadewing's initial ATK,, the curse lashes out, dealing damage equal to + 4% (SP-based) of the enemy's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 600% (ATK-based) + 90% (SP-based). The curse lashes out at most once every 3s per enemy.
active: When a battle starts, Shadewing soars into the enemy formation, inflicting Withering Curse on all enemies.
During the flight, Shadewing is invincible.
Withering Curse reduces enemies' Phys & Magic DEF by 20% and converts any continuous damage they take into curse value.
When the curse value reaches the lesser of 20% of an enemy's max HP or 400% of Shadewing's initial ATK,, the curse lashes out, dealing damage equal to + 4% (SP-based) of the enemy's max HP.
This damage cannot exceed 600% (ATK-based) + 90% (SP-based).
The curse lashes out at most once every 3s per enemy.

text: Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 30% + 4% (SP-based) of the enemy's max HP.
This damage cannot exceed 700% (ATK-based) + 90% (SP-based).
Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 35% + 4% (SP-based) of the enemy's max HP.
This damage cannot exceed 800% (ATK-based) + 90% (SP-based).
Increases the damage dealt when the curse lashes out to 40% + 4% (SP-based) of the enemy's max HP.
This damage cannot exceed 900% (ATK-based) + 90% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Shadewing converts any continuous damage enemies take into curse value. Once the curse value reaches a set threshold, it lashes out, dealing heavy damage.

active: Increases ATK by 12% during battle.

text: Increases ATK by 16% during battle.
Increases ATK by 20% during battle.

skills.name: Curse Feast

description.raw: Every time Withering Curse lashes out, Shadewing recovers 100 Energy and permanently increases his damage dealt by 6%, up to 36%. When an Enemy with Crimson Venom is defeated, Shadewing reclaims the venom's residual essence and recovers 50 Energy for each second of Crimson Venom's remaining duration.
active: Every time Withering Curse lashes out, Shadewing recovers 100 Energy and permanently increases his damage dealt by 6%, up to 36%.
When an Enemy with Crimson Venom is defeated, Shadewing reclaims the venom's residual essence and recovers 50 Energy for each second of Crimson Venom's remaining duration.

text: Increases the max damage boost Shadewing can gain from Withering Curse's lash to 42%.
Converts 85% of the damage dealt by Withering Curse's lash into true damage.
Increases the max damage boost Shadewing can gain from Withering Curse's lash to 48%.

skills.description_lite: Shadewing recovers Energy and gains a permanent damage boost whenever Withering Curse lashes out or an enemy with Crimson Venom is defeated.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When a battle starts, Shadewing targets the ally 1 tile in front of him and drains 10% of their current HP. He also gains a 30% ATK boost, 30 Life Drain, and a shield equal to 500% of the HP drained, up to 500% of his ATK. The effects last until the end of the battle.
active: When a battle starts, Shadewing targets the ally 1 tile in front of him and drains 10% of their current HP.
He also gains a 30% ATK boost, 30 Life Drain, and a shield equal to 500% of the HP drained, up to 500% of his ATK.
The effects last until the end of the battle.

skills.description_lite: When a battle starts, Shadewing drains HP from the ally 1 tile in front of him to gain a shield and stat bonuses.
